strings.subtitle: — Fael u Kwasen —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Zamber kwagh u a fatyô. Zamber kwagh u a we hii.
strings.ft_lnk: Uzenden kpishi (.lnk) — a fatyô u veren
strings.ssd_warning: Kera! Kwa SSD, ikyav u a fatyô u kwasen ga TRIM. Program u a kera HDD kwagh.
strings.confirm_text:
Fael "{name}" a gema u kwasen.

Dondon?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Una mi shortcut (.lnk). Shortcut wene ka kera.

Fāili u a nenge ka tembe.

Vende?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Una mi network drive (\\server\share).
Kera sektô ka kera ye — server ka mi snapshot, deduplication shin CoW.

Vende?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Una mi removable drive (USB / HDD).
Controller ka kera blocks iyol yô.

Vende?
strings.error_cannot_read:
Fael kwagh u a fatyô u lengen:
{err}
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS uzenden u a we (ADS) kwagh u a er.
• USN ikyav u a zenden.
• Kwagh fan u a we u wingu
  (OneDrive u a we) kwagh u a kera.
strings.status_full: Kwagh cii a gema u zenda. Kwagh u a fatyô u zenden — ikyav i zenda kwagh.
strings.status_fast: Ityough, mkur u 4 MB imese a gema. Kwagh u a we kwagh u a er, shin zenden u a we, fael kwagh u a fatyô u zenden. Zamber ikyav u KPO kwagh u a kera.
strings.status_empty: Fael zenda, gema kwagh u a fatyô. Kwasen.
strings.error_permission: I lu a kera fāili ye. Ka mi hen program ugen yô. Kera iyol a vende.
strings.error_not_found: Fāili i kôr ye. I kera iyol a.
strings.error_is_symlink: Una mi symbolic link. Link ka kera ye — fāili u a nenge ka tembe.
strings.error_reparse: Una mi placeholder fāili (OneDrive shin u a lu a). Data a mi cloud yô, disk yô ye — ka mi kwagh u kera hen.
strings.error_not_file: Una mi fāili ye (folder shin kwagh ugen). Dra fāili.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fāili un a mi hard link ({n} tese). Hard link ka mi môm ye — iti tese lu a môm. U lu a kera ne iyol u a, data ka kera sha 32 bytes, nahan iyol iyol ka tembe hen link ugen yô. Kera link tese hen.
strings.error_compressed:
Fāili i compressed, encrypted shin sparse. Kera ne zero ka kera data iyol ye sha kwagh u NTFS ka mi hen sha kwagh ugen.

Kera attribute: klik uhemba → Properties → Advanced → kera 'Compress' shin/hen 'Encrypt'. Nahan lu a SHREDDER a.
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Fāili {count} ka kera.
Ukur u tese: {size}.

Kôr iyol iyol hen u lu a.
Iyu ka cii ye.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Kera fāili tese {count} ijime iyol yô?

Fāili mbahen A KERA ye — iyol wene.
strings.hardlink_text:
Fāili "{name}" a mi hard link ({nlink} tese).

Data ka kera sha iti tese.
Nahan iyol iyol (32 bytes) ka tembe hen iti tese yô.

U ka kera iyol iyol ne uwe.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Mbahen sha hard link tese yô
strings.queue_reason_cannot_read: i lu a kera ukur ye
